prompt: Can you please explain inflation to me, as if I was kid?
response: Inflation is when the prices of things you buy every day, like toys and candy, slowly go up over time. It's like if your favorite toy costs $10 today, it might cost $12 next year. This happens because the money we have isn't worth as much as it used to be. Inflation is a normal part of the economy, and it's usually around 2% each year in most countries.
